text.p: - Russia's gold reserves are nearly exhausted, says the Audit Chamber after inspecting the State Jewellery Fund.
- If any accident happens at a mine in the north of the Kuzbas region, there would be no one to help because rescue workers there are on strike.
- The World Bank has reacted negatively to the plan to merge two Russian telecommunication giants.
- The main aim of Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin's visit to Paris is to support good Franco-Russian political ties with close economic cooperation.
- The Chechen side has rather arbitrarily interpreted the agreement signed by Chernomyrdin and Maskhadov on Saturday, saying that Russia has to pay $130-150 billion in reparations.
- Russia must pay the tsarist-era debts because they lower the country's loan rating.
- The referendum in Belarus proved that the people support President Alexander Lukashenko and his deep concern about the collapse of the single Motherland.
- President Boris Yeltsin's family is playing a more and more important role in the country's politics.
